Maria — thanks for sending this and for the quick sync. Attaching our completed worksheet and a first-pass DPA annex for SummitCare to review. High-level summary here so your team can triage:

1) EU->US transfers:
- Default: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) adopted + documented supplementary technical and organizational measures (see "Redwood_DPF_Response_SummitCare.xlsx", tab: Transfers).
- We also offer an optional private deployment (VPC/on-prem) for regulated workloads; if you want that route, we can scope separately.

2) Encryption & KMS:
- Encryption at rest: AES-256; keys managed in customer-isolated KMS for Dedicated/Private customers or our managed KMS (Google Cloud KMS / AWS KMS) for Hosted customers.
- Key rotation: 90 days recommended; rotation policy documented in our security runbook.

3) Subprocessors:
- Current list included in the worksheet (page 2) and in the annex. We commit to 30-day notice for additions and a quarterly published list.

4) Evidence:
- We attached a short evidence pack (drive link in metadata) with architecture diagrams, SCC adoption statement, and encryption configuration examples. For anything you need that we can't publish in the public docs, we can provide a redacted, signed attestation under NDA.

Next steps:

Maria / Kimberly — quick technical clarifications expanding on the worksheet entries (quoting Kimberly below).

On Tue, Jun 5, 2028 at 11:48 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> 1) EU->US transfers: SCCs + supplementary measures.

Responses / evidence pointers:
- Network & routing: For Hosted customers we route inference traffic through regional endpoints; EU-origin requests remain in EU regions where possible unless specifically routed to US by customer policy. See Console > Regions > Data Flow tab for per-tenant routing logs (we can provide an export).
- KV cache & persistence: By default, models use ephemeral KV caches that are not persisted to disk. Any persisted state is limited to explicit customer-managed storage and is documented in the response workbook.
- Logging / audit: We provide per-tenant audit logs with token-level redaction and 90-day retention by default (configurable). Exportable logs for audits are delivered as signed CSV bundles.
- Key management: For Hosted: managed KMS integrations listed (GCP, AWS) with endpoint names in the workbook. For Dedicated/Private: you can bring your own KMS/HSM and provide keys; we support both envelope encryption and customer KMS control plane integration.

If SummitCare has a specific evidence nugget they need (e.g., KMS key ARN + rotation proof for a sample tenant), we can provide a redacted artifact under the usual NDA and with a short MOU.

I suggest the Thursday call include a 10-minute technical deep dive where we can show: routing logs, sample audit export, and KMS config screenshots.

—Rishi
Lead, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
